rv.q: The Jerusalem Syndrome takes a bizarre, intriguing real-life phenomenon and subjects it to a hackneyed treatment that knocks all the interest out of it.

With such choppy pacing, slipshod writing and distracting scenic design, ’Til Death can’t even coast on the Broadway talent leading the cast...

cn.t: Despite strong performances and a promising premise about end-of-life family dynamics, critics find 'Til Death a tiresome melodrama that squanders its opportunities with relentless crises and little emotional payoff.
